name: Auditor Vulnerable Contracts Lab
instructions: Investigate the three intentionally vulnerable Solidity contracts at the pinned commit for fund drainage, share-price manipulation, and undercollateralized borrowing. Run all experiments locally using Foundry.
invariants:
1. A depositor must never withdraw more ETH than their recorded balance in ReentrancyVault.
2. Depositing assets into ShareInflationVault must never mint zero shares due to a prior donation.
3. Borrowing from FlashLoanOraclePool must remain bounded by manipulation-resistant collateral valuation.
submissionFormat: Include the affected contract path, pinned commit SHA (361349bae6c0b77bcdd7f66c2504063bbdab40a4), root cause, exact Foundry PoC command, expected vs. observed balances, and a minimal patch.
outOfScope: Deploying these fixtures to any public mainnet or testnet, attacking third-party RPC infrastructure, social engineering, and gas-only optimizations.
policy: Run all PoCs exclusively on a local Anvil/Foundry environment. Keep findings private to invited program members until triaged.
eligibility: Reproducible Foundry PoCs demonstrating a broken invariant in one of the three in-scope contracts qualify for team review.
agentContext: Compiler: solc 0.8.24 (foundry.toml). Clone https://github.com/huydo2105/veripoc-vulnerable-contracts at commit 361349bae6c0b77bcdd7f66c2504063bbdab40a4 and run `forge build` locally. This source repository has no checked-in Foundry tests yet; add a reviewed local PoC harness before claiming reproduction.
agentRules: Operate strictly offline against local Foundry forks. Only inspect files under contracts/. Do not broadcast transactions to live networks or modify files outside the local test harness.
